claims.text: TTJA (CPTRA) reports active monitoring of e-commerce, services providing access to audiovisual media services, and financial services.
claims.authority_or_court: Consumer Protection and Technical Regulatory Authority (TTJA/CPTRA)
claims.legal_basis: Products and Services Accessibility Act, identified in the authority's EAA reply; this pass does not independently interpret legal duties.
claims.stage_detail: Financial services is the source wording; Banking is a navigation category, not an inferred narrower or expanded remit. No formal warning, order or penalty inferred.
